tagline.en: NVIDIA's generative 3D and 4D world model — turn inputs into explorable scenes.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA 的生成式 3D/4D 世界模型——把输入转化为可探索的场景。

en: Lyra is a generative 3D and 4D world model from NVIDIA's Spatial Intelligence Lab. Rather than producing a flat video, it builds a scene you can look around and move through, aimed at open, generative world generation.

WorldFoundry ships both Lyra-1 and Lyra-2 pipelines, with Lyra-2 as the default and Lyra-1 available as an explicit variant. Alongside the world model it uses a Depth Anything 3 asset for geometry, and it includes a native World Explorer for interactive rendering.
In WorldFoundry you pick the Lyra variant you want and run it through the shared pipeline. Runtime execution needs local Lyra checkpoints, the text-encoder and DA3 assets, and a working CUDA setup.
zh: Lyra 是 NVIDIA Spatial Intelligence Lab 推出的生成式 3D/4D 世界模型。它不生成平面视频，而是构建一个可以环视、可以在其中移动的场景，面向开放式的生成式世界生成。
WorldFoundry 同时提供 Lyra-1 与 Lyra-2 两条 pipeline，默认使用 Lyra-2，Lyra-1 作为显式变体保留。除世界模型外，它还借助 Depth Anything 3 资产处理几何，并自带一个用于交互式渲染的原生 World Explorer。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你选定想用的 Lyra 变体，通过统一 pipeline 运行即可。运行时需要本地 Lyra checkpoint、文本编码器与 DA3 资产，以及可用的 CUDA 环境。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Lyra when you want to generate an explorable 3D/4D scene rather than a fixed clip — for spatial world building and interactive exploration. Lyra-2 is the recommended starting point.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想生成一个可探索的 3D/4D 场景、而非固定片段时，选择 Lyra——适合空间世界构建与交互式探索。Lyra-2 是推荐的起点。

notFor.en: Not a lightweight or plug-and-play model: it depends on local checkpoints, text-encoder and DA3 assets, and CUDA runtime dependencies, so plan for the setup and hardware.
notFor.zh: 它不是轻量或即插即用的模型：依赖本地 checkpoint、文本编码器与 DA3 资产，以及 CUDA 运行时依赖，请预留环境搭建与硬件资源。

en: Generative 3D and 4D world model, not just video
Lyra-1 and Lyra-2 pipelines, with Lyra-2 as the default
Native World Explorer for interactive rendering
zh: 生成式 3D/4D 世界模型，而不仅是视频
同时提供 Lyra-1 与 Lyra-2，默认 Lyra-2
自带原生 World Explorer 交互式渲染
出自 NVIDIA Spatial Intelligence Lab
